source: Ruiz-Santaquiteria et al., Data in Brief 52 (2024) 110030, Tables 1-3

categories.Handgun: a person carries, aims or reloads a handgun (a pistol)
categories.Machine_Gun: a person carries, aims or reloads a long gun, such as a rifle or a machine gun
categories.No_Gun: a person without any firearm walks, jogs, runs or sneaks with empty hands, or holds a phone, a water bottle or soda can, or something heavy

carry.meaning: carries a firearm without aiming it; it may point at the floor or the ceiling

aim.meaning: aims a firearm, including reloading it while aiming

move.meaning: walks, jogs, runs or sneaks with empty hands

phone.meaning: holds a phone, looks at it or records a video with it

bottle.meaning: holds a water bottle or soda can, or drinks from it

heavy_object.meaning: holds something heavy with both hands
